claims: Eintracht Frankfurt and 1. FC Köln drew 2-2 on April 5, 2026.
The match was at Deutsche Bank Park, Frankfurt.
The match was a Bundesliga match on Matchday 28.
Burkardt scored the 1-0 goal in the 66th minute.
Kalimuendo scored the 2-0 goal in the 69th minute.
Kaminski scored the 2-1 goal in the 70th minute.
Castro-Montes scored the 2-2 goal in the 83rd minute.
Eintracht Frankfurt was in 7th place with 39 points.
1. FC Köln was in 15th place with 27 points
